title: Youre Still Here

nodes.speaker: Zee Burke
nodes.text: Well I'm glad you did. Day or night, it's such an otherworldly view, isn't it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well I'm glad you did. Day or night, it's such an otherworldly view, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Zee Burke
nodes.text: Don't you agree? The city is such a contrast to the endless sky above the water. It's almost ethereal. A beacon to those traveling the waves.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Don't you agree? The city is such a contrast to the endless sky above the water. It's almost ethereal. A beacon to those traveling the waves.

nodes.speaker: Zee Burke
nodes.text: I have another question for you, if you'd be willing to indulge me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have another question for you, if you'd be willing to indulge me.

nodes.speaker: Zee Burke
nodes.text: That's... Thank you. It's nice to share this moment with you. I have another question if you'd be willing to indulge me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's... Thank you. It's nice to share this moment with you. I have another question if you'd be willing to indulge me.

nodes.speaker: Zee Burke
nodes.text: Are you from here? Nivalis that is?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you from here? Nivalis that is?

nodes.speaker: Zee Burke
nodes.text: I thought so. You have the city's aura around you. If you're not careful, it'll take over. I've seen it happen to so many others.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I thought so. You have the city's aura around you. If you're not careful, it'll take over. I've seen it happen to so many others.

nodes.speaker: Zee Burke
nodes.text: Just because it seems to be, doesn't mean it has to.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just because it seems to be, doesn't mean it has to.

nodes.speaker: Zee Burke
nodes.text: I don't think we'll know until we find it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't think we'll know until we find it.

nodes.speaker: Zee Burke
nodes.text: Maybe one day it won't be. Hopefully I'll be here when it's not.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe one day it won't be. Hopefully I'll be here when it's not.

nodes.speaker: Zee Burke
nodes.text: I knew it! From the first second you came up here, I could tell there was something different about you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I knew it! From the first second you came up here, I could tell there was something different about you.

nodes.speaker: Zee Burke
nodes.text: Being a bit different is always a good thing. It helps you keep a sound mind and an open eye. It helps you keep looking.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Being a bit different is always a good thing. It helps you keep a sound mind and an open eye. It helps you keep looking.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Actually, I didn't come back for the view.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Actually, I didn't come back for the view.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Actually, I didn't come back for the view.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Actually, I didn't come back for the view.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No. I wandered in one day and just haven't left.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No. I wandered in one day and just haven't left.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: No. I wandered in one day and just haven't left.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: No. I wandered in one day and just haven't left.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's a little hippy dippy for me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's a little hippy dippy for me.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That's a little hippy dippy for me.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That's a little hippy dippy for me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I saw that you were still here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I saw that you were still here.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I saw that you were still here.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I saw that you were still here.
